description.en: Picks a random technique/tactic ID from a character's or team's known set of the given kind, optionally excluding a list of already-picked IDs (useful for drawing several distinct random skills/tactics in a row without repeats).
Selects whether to pick from techniques (per-character) or tactics (per-team), and which owner argument to use.
When true, look the owner up by numeric index instead of by ID string.
Character or team ID (string or number, depending on byNumber) to draw from.
Optional additional IDs (up to 9) to exclude from the random pick, typically previously drawn results.
A randomly chosen ID not present in the exclude list (0 if no eligible candidate remains); null if fewer than 2 arguments were given.
